question: Does making Faultline rare remove Scoreline-driven RandomBuild movement while preserving planned acquisition and the admitted package mechanics?

shippingChangesAtThisStage: Duskblade Chisel applies one Scoreline; rare Faultline consumes it for 12 or 15 bonus damage and completes the target's remaining Facets.
Duskblade Ward applies one Afterimage; Warden's Edge consumes it to deal damage equal to three times the current Ward.
The balance pilot gives a package-completing reward four times its sampled aspect weight; Ward receives that weight once in combat only when Warden's Edge is held and no Afterimage is active.

localGateReuse.reason: V38 changes only Faultline rarity; fixed-deck combat definitions, combat rules and pilot combat scoring are byte-identical to V37.

researchCohorts.screen: root 539, policy indices 0-511, seeds 337000-337003, Duskblade Vow-5
researchCohorts.repertoireValidation: selected route-active cells, seeds 338000-338063, paired candidate/live Duskblade Vow-5

estimands.functionalSeparation: Every named diagonal lower 95% bound is at least 0.25 SD and every off-diagonal upper bound is below 0.25.
estimands.globalMovement: Candidate-minus-live RandomBuild arm-2 point movement is at most 0.10 per grid.
estimands.routeViability: Each Dusk route has at least two held-out policies at least 0.35 above paired RandomBuild.
estimands.reliability: No candidate-added stall or simulator error.
estimands.vow5: Every selected-policy Vow-5 win rate is at most 0.90.

successRule: Reused local gates and both control splits admit, then each Dusk route retains two distinct Vow-5 endpoints with zero reliability regression and the Vow-5 ceiling.
inconclusiveRule: A non-decisive discovery control may fill its frozen 64-seed cohort; the held-out control and route rectangles are final.
stopRule: Reject on controls, fewer than eight active screen cells per route, fewer than two held-out endpoints, collapse, added fault or Vow-5 above 0.90.
